meaning: guilty, faulty (and obliged to offer a guilt-offering)

elsewhere.note: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen.…
The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king…
They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
